STAG CAT
CR 1

This small wild cat, sports long legs and a set of majestic antlers. It raises its head from the body of its prey to survey you in a manner reminiscent of deer.

XP 400
N Small magical beast
Init +3; Senses scent; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +3 natural armor, +1 size)
hp 16 (3d10)
Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +5 (1d6) or bite +5 (1d4) and 2 claws +5 (1d3)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 14, Con 10, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 7
Base Attack +3; CMB +2; CMD 14 (18 vs. trip)
Feats Dodge B, Mobility B, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +6, Perception +10, Stealth +10

ECOLOGY

Environment any forest
Organization solitary, pair, or herd (3–12)
Treasure none

This odd creature is a lanky, flighty feline with deer-like horns. They do not use the horns for hunting prey, but only in defense and in disputes between each other.
